selection: Prespecified cash/allocation factorial. Same deposits, target preset, reserve budget, costs, calendar and hard action gates within every comparison. Starts overlap and are not independent out-of-sample evidence.

exampleNine.explanation: No pre-listing rows, synthetic prices, proxy substitution, or annualized short-IPO return. Full strategy return requires all symbols and the 52-week risk lookback.

draftEleven.explanation: No pre-listing rows, synthetic prices, proxy substitution, or annualized short-IPO return. Full strategy return requires all symbols and the 52-week risk lookback.

frozenSix.explanation: No pre-listing rows, synthetic prices, proxy substitution, or annualized short-IPO return. Full strategy return requires all symbols and the 52-week risk lookback.

coverage.exampleConfiguration: Independent illustrative nine-asset targets using the same asset list; not user account settings.

assumptions.signal: prior raw close and weekly raw closes as on dashboard (adjusted fallback in synthetic fixtures); adjusted OHLC for total-return execution and valuation
assumptions.deposits: 400 at first trading day of each calendar month, before returns; weekly DCA pools only, excluding the separate independent Dip pool
assumptions.budget: 300 normal + 100 Crash per month; calendar Tuesdays identified by plannedDate; missing execution does not redistribute its budget
assumptions.strategies: balanced_weekly_v2 freezes the prior 30% cash policy with current hard gates; named variants use the shared planner with explicit cash/allocation modes; legacy comparisons are research ablations only
assumptions.currency: constant currency research units; no historical CAD FX series
